title: Repository configuration
description: The overlay file .agent-code-review/config.json of a reviewed repository. It is always read from the target branch; a copy changed in the change request is ignored.

profile.description: Kind of repository. When absent, it is detected from the files.

packs.description: Stack packs to use. When absent, they are detected from the files.

variants.description: Build variants or flavors, for example free and paid.

dimensions.description: Values of the dimensions of the stack packs, for example the UI toolkit. A value set here wins over detection from the files.

additionalProperties.description: Value of the dimension named by the key.

disabledRules.description: Rules that are not applied in this repository.

noise.description: Extra globs of changed files that are listed as noise and not reviewed.

cascade.description: Limits of the Related Changes cascade. They apply when the review starts from a change request of this repository; the root change request's repository sets the limits for the whole cascade.

maxDepth.description: Deepest level of Related Changes that is reviewed; the root is level 0. The default is 3.

maxChangeRequests.description: Most change requests reviewed in one cascade, the root included, counted in discovery order. The default is 10.

dimensionId.description: Identifier of a dimension or of one of its values: lowercase words joined by hyphens.

glob.description: Path glob with forward slashes: '*' matches within a segment, '**' matches any number of segments.

packId.description: Stack pack identifier, for example android or kotlin-multiplatform.

profile.description: Kind of repository, which selects the default criteria.

ruleId.description: Rule identifier: lowercase words joined by hyphens, optionally in dot-separated groups, for example no-double-bang.
